[issue by hiimrickross]
### Checklist

- [x] I am reporting a defect, not asking for help
- [x] I have searched existing issues and this has not been reported
- [x] I have reduced my mod list to the minimum required to reproduce this issue (see below)

### Bug Description

https://github.com/zomabies/RestoreChatLinks/issues/11

Over the time that I've been building my personal/friend group modpack, I've periodically received a crash on boot with this error: 

[crash-2026-09-21_15.31.17-client.txt](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/32453279/crash-2026-09-21_15.31.17-client.txt)

Note: The first mod blamed "at TRANSFORMER/advancementoverhaul@0.10/dev.ethan.advancementoverhaul.client.AdvancementOverhaulClient.onScreenOpening(AdvancementOverhaulClient.java:36) ~[advancementoverhaul-0.10.jar%23562!/:?] {re:classloading}" is not relevant - if you remove whatever it blames, it blames something else, and so forth and so forth. The culprit is (whatever recent mod installed that triggers this).

For my case, the most recent one I can remember is Restore Chat Links (1.21.1 Neoforge).
When I add it to my modpack, this error triggers.

When I Remove it, I can play just fine.

When I add this mod but remove Modernfix, I can also play just fine.

Do you perhaps have any um... well, smarter, eyes/insight into this? AI diagnosis is not that reliable but it talks about something with Restore Chat Links reporting jar tampering or something...


"SecurityException: Jar Has been tampered! true false false
at restorechatlinks.neoforge.IntegrityVerifier.selfVerify

ModernFix appears to alter or clear NeoForge’s SecureJar metadata during startup. Restore Chat Links’ overzealous integrity verifier then interprets the missing trust metadata as a tampered JAR and aborts. With ModernFix disabled, that metadata remains available and RCL loads."

Whether that's all true or not idk.. But something of note is that out of 400-ish mods explored/tested, I'd say about ~5 throughout that time trigger this issue - so it's very rare.

### Minimal Mod List

I think perhaps Modernfix, 1.21.1 Neoforge, and Restore Chat Links might be enough to trigger it.

This is the settings I have for modernfix too:
```

[comment by embeddedt (owner)]
The model is in this case likely correct; ModernFix has a memory optimization that removes the manifest hash data because it consumes several MB by itself and is typically not used at runtime. However there seems to be a pattern of mods starting to use it for integrity verification. I guess I will have to limit the optimization to vanilla's own data only.
